applicability.featureGate: None for the displayed stable policy/v1 fields at the pinned snapshot
applicability.discovery: Require exact available policy/v1 discovery and schema; permission remains independently authoritative
applicability.permission: Available create/update capability required; denied, unknown and unavailable never grant writes
applicability.installation: Native API; no operator installation implied
applicability.identity: Host owns create identity and locks name/namespace on edit
applicability.specMutability: Displayed specification fields are mutable; host schema admission constrains each patch
applicability.ownership: Declarative desired-state policy under explicit create/edit intent; host restricts actual controller ownerReferences or trusted controller/system/installer evidence. Editor policy never grants RBAC permission.
applicability.status: Read-only, controller-owned; generation comparison uses exact scalars

fields.behavior: Atomic remove alternative plus set chosen rule; explicit omitted choice preserves API omission
Nonnegative int32 bigint or 0–100 percentage string; revision-scoped local input derives from its canonical budget baseline without effect resets, retaining partial text across sibling edits

Explicit omitted versus null matches no Pods; all-Pods selection explicitly removes owned requirement leaves before setting {}, and null/object transitions are atomic remove-and-set operations preserving unowned siblings
Qualified Kubernetes label key/value validation; leaf operations preserve expression rows

In/NotIn require values; Exists/DoesNotExist atomically omit values; stable row identities keep pending token text attached during sibling deletion, and indexed edits retain comments and unedited leaves
Real scoped core/v1 pods metadata lookup, AND matching, cancellation/session guards, denied/absent/unavailable/empty distinct; no readiness/controller compatibility/permission claim
Omitted default, IfHealthyBudget or AlwaysAllow; AlwaysAllow consequence remains visible
Missing or stale observed generation warns; no inferred eviction authority

fields.control: Advanced read-only conditions and pending disruptions
fields.behavior: Conditions show type/status/reason/time, pending disruptions show Pod/time; arbitrary condition message is not replayed into user errors
Unsupported selector shapes/policies retain exact source in YAML fallback; known leaves remain bidirectional; projected containers never submitted as mutation values

boundaries.Eviction: No persisted Eviction contribution. Existing Pod action owns POST /api/v1/namespaces/{namespace}/pods/{name}/eviction. Transport is exact Pod-context scoped; PDB editor cannot execute cross-target evictions or infer admission success.
boundaries.status: No status path owned by contribution; controller rejects status patches.
boundaries.controllerCompatibility: maxUnavailable warns about compatible scalable-controller ownership; Pod metadata does not prove compatibility.
boundaries.sourcePrivacy: No source values, credentials, annotations or preferences persisted by this group. Host owns source, masking and explicit mode preference.

verification: Not run by worker. Parent owns coherent checks and screenshot wave.
